title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1990-12-27
lineage: FOB AKG 460/CK61 (ORTF) > Mike Grace Early Preamp > Dat Master (Casio DA-7/48k) > Dat (Sony R500) > Behringer UltraMatch SRC2000 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with upfront, full‑left sound and a standout moment when Jerry sings “Comes A Time”.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the fat, upfront stereo image of this audience capture – left channel noticeably fuller, likely recorded near Phil’s side. The performance shines especially on Jerry’s vocal rendition of “Comes A Time”, which drew an enthusiastic crowd reaction.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight superb sound quality and a memorable vocal moment, giving the recording a solid rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upfront, fat stereo image; left channel fuller than right, suggesting placement near Phil's side of stage. Captures clear crowd reaction and strong instrument separation.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; focus is on the highlighted vocal moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal entry on “Comes A Time” generated a notable crowd reaction and was praised by reviewers.
